about: A three-branch gh stack in acme-web, every PR squash-merged, so no squash commit holds the one below it. #70 (slice-3 into slice-2) is squashed as w070; slice-2 is then w070, #71's head. #71 (slice-2 into slice-1) is squashed as w071, whose only parent is slice-1's old tip; slice-1 is then w071, #72's head. #72 (slice-1 into main) is squashed as w072 on main. #70's change reaches main only through #71's and #72's squash commits.
